metadata.name: parallel-execution-optimizer
metadata.description: Speed up a task by turning it into a dependency graph of parallel lanes with a lane matrix, batched reads and checks, write surfaces isolated by file, worktree, branch, or service, and a final verification table. Use when the user wants a task done much faster through parallel work, concurrent agents, batched tool calls, isolated worktrees, or many independent verification lanes without losing correctness.
metadata.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob
